On netstandard2.0 nothing can override HttpMessageHandler.Send: C# emits newslot for a non-override virtual. This is a design-level gap, not a 4.4 defect. A read scope observes its result only when it ends. A tool that reads and then egresses within the same call (read a file, then post to a webhook or push to a forge) has that egress decided at the pre-read mark.
